macros.name: UDIVMOD_GUARDED
macros.operation: Unsigned divide-and-remainder with the historical MIPS divide-by-zero guard
macros.rationale: Original words at libc2/33-prnt 0x46C are divu/bnez/nop/break/mflo/mfhi; modern GNU as reorders the guard, and the historical expansion as a shared operation makes the whole member byte-exact while removing it compiles to a non-match
